text:
carol: FYI I opened a TF change to carve a dedicated egress subnet for k8s nodes + add PrivateLink endpoints for registry/s3. Want quick eyes on routing and secrets wiring before I merge. plan attached below.

carol: TL;DR: create subnet `k8s-egress-2`, attach route table that points 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-gw (elastic ip pool), add aws_vpc_endpoint for com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 and ecr.api, plus a small kubelet annotation so node traffic prefers the egress subnet.

carol: snippets:
```hcl
resource "aws_subnet" "k8s_egress" {
  vpc_id            = var.vpc_id
  cidr_block        = "10.40.64.0/22"
  availability_zone = data.aws_availability_zones.azs.names[0]
  tags = { Name = "k8s-egress-2" }
}
resource "aws_route_table" "k8s_egress_rt" {
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
}
resource "aws_route" "egress_default" {
  route_table_id         = aws_route_table.k8s_egress_rt.id
  destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
  nat_gateway_id         = aws_nat_gateway.egress.id
}
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "s3_pl" {
  vpc_id            = var.vpc_id
  service_name      = "com.amazonaws.${var.region}.s3"
  route_table_ids   = [aws_route_table.k8s_egress_rt.id]
  vpc_endpoint_type = "Gateway"
}
```

carol: plan summary generated by CI: +3 resources, ~1kB alloc, no destructive changes. attach: `plan-2061234567.txt` (CI).

sam: quick Q — how does the kubelet annotation get applied? Are we changing the node daemonset or using a mutating webhook?

carol: not changing daemonsets. plan is to set `k8s.io/node-egress-subnet` annotation in the bootstrap userdata for new nodes (ASG launch template). Old nodes will be cordoned/drained during the roll.

mike: does this require new IAM perms for the node role to call STS / describe ENIs etc?

carol: no extra IAM for node role. The NAT/Egress is infra-only. nodes just source traffic; we only need the control-plane to be able to tag route associations during deployment (the TF apply runs under infra CI role).

sre-jen: check NACLs — are we opening ephemeral ports both ways? current worker NACL is restrictive. If egress-subnet uses different NACL we may block kube-proxy health checks.

carol: good catch. I updated the PR to explicitly allow outbound ephemeral (1024-65535) and established return. snippet in PR: `aws_network_acl_rule.egress_ephemeral`

ops-bot: [plan] apply will create 1 nat gateway, 1 subnet, 1 route_table, 2 vpc_endpoints. No tainted resources. CI: plan ok :white_check_mark:

sam: lgtm overall. One nit: can we use route propagation to avoid duplicating route entries later? or is the NAT static so it's fine?

carol: NAT is static for now (reserved EIP). We discussed dynamic TGW routing but opted for predictable egress IP for allowlists. If we later move to TGW we'll migrate the assoc.

mike: also confirm: ECR PrivateLink endpoint is interface type — did you add subnet ids for endpoint ENIs?

carol: yes `aws_vpc_endpoint.ecr_api` is interface type and uses the same `k8s-egress` subnet id list; security group is the `infra-endpoint-sg` that only allows outbound to AWS-managed IPs.

sre-jen: FYI I'll run a small staging apply tomorrow 02:00 UTC to validate healthchecks and node egress telemetry. Please don't merge until I ack.

carol: noted. I'll hold the merge. Thanks for checking.

sam: one more: secrets wiring — route table associations are done in TF, but who has the key to update the launch template userdata secret? We need to ensure ops/secrets rotation doesn't break bootstrap.

carol: userdata lives in secrets manager `infra/node-bootstrap/userdata` and the infra CI role can update it. I've added a docs link in the PR describing rotation process: https://redwood.internal/docs/infra/bootstrap-rotation

mike: pinging @carol for a small inline change: use `count` var for subnets so we can create across AZs if we need to scale. otherwise :+1:

carol: good call — updated code. will rerun plan post-staging test.

sre-jen: after staging apply I'll validate:
- node egress IPs from `agent` metrics
- S3/ECR lookups via PrivateLink
- kube-proxy and node readiness windows

carol: thanks all. I'll post the staging plan output once it's done and tag you. :rocket:

sam: thanks — will review the final plan.

mike: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: [apply] staging apply scheduled at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z by sre-jen

carol: merge blocked until staging validation complete per jen.
